name: All Bright Cleaning Company
failed_reason: Minimum photo bar not met per PIPELINE.md fase 3. The Google Maps listing's photo carousel (node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js, 24 requested) returned only 5 images total, and all 5 are generic marketing graphics, not real photos of the business or its work: two 'Pet Friendly' badge icons, a '100% Guarantee' stamp graphic, a 'We Accept the Following Cards' payment-logos graphic, and one stock-looking photo of a person wiping a window (no branding, no verifiable connection to this specific crew/property). Verified visually via contact sheet (output/allbrightcleaning/_sheet.jpg) before rejecting. Extended search for a real owned social profile to source more photos: WebSearch for 'All Bright Cleaning Company Miramar FL instagram', 'facebook', 'website', 'yelp', and reverse-lookup of the phone number +1 954-516-9714 and a site:homeadvisor.com Miramar-scoped search. No Instagram or Facebook account could be found for this specific business (identity confirmed by phone/city). Several similarly-named HomeAdvisor/Thumbtack/HomeGuide listings exist nationwide ('All Bright Cleaning, LLC', 'All Bright Cleaning Service', 'All Bright Cleaners, LLC', 'AllBright Shine Cleaning Co.', etc.) but none could be verified as this exact Miramar, FL business (no matching phone number or address found on any of them), so none were used as a photo source per the no-fabrication rule. No domain (allbrightcleaning.com / allbrightcleaningcompany.com) resolves to this business either (has_own_site: false, confirmed separately). Conclusion: fewer than 5 verifiable real photos of real cleaning work exist for this business; per the brief this is marked failed rather than padded with stock/generic imagery. Reviews (4 distinct real verbatim Google reviews found: Kara Williams, Iman Murray, Jessica B, Ann Howell, all 5-star except Jessica B 3-star) and contact info were successfully gathered and are usable if a photo source is found later, but the site was not built.
